gui.guhs.guhwinter_hoentjes.noway.alpine: (IN THE SNOW!! Nobody is going to believe this. VAHOEG!!)
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.guhwinter_waterho: Rarity: Rare (at the water's edge in the Guhmension: ponds, lakes and streams)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guhwinter_waterhoen: A round dark little bird with a red shield on its forehead, a red bill with a yellow tip and very long green toes (with a red garter!). It nods its head with every step, likes swimming just as much as walking and keeps flicking its white tail. Very shy: sneak closer. Krr-uk, njeg!
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.guhwinter_alpineh: Rarity: Rare (high up in the mountains and in the snow of the Guhmension)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.guhwinter_alpinehoe: A little ball of snow with guh ears: all white in winter, with a black line by its eyes and a small red comb above them. Its feet are thickly feathered, just like snowshoes. It doesn't walk, it hops! In the snow you can hardly see it. Even shyer than the moorhen.
